note: AFU prostate. 'Indications therapeutiques' states one risk group per numbered recommendation, so those headings carry the routing and everything beneath them inherits it.

default.note: The document is overwhelmingly about non-metastatic prostate cancer, so an unclaimed passage is that -- with the risk group not narrowed. 116 of 144 passages land here, which is high; narrowing it is corpus work, not a format problem.

rules.note: Screening and early detection address men who do not yet have a diagnosis. Routing them as prostate cancer guidance would return screening advice for a patient already staged.
The Python used a word-boundary regex. Verified against the fixture: 'cn1' occurs in one heading and in no longer word, so a substring match is equivalent here.

Named as a path fragment, not a word. A bare 'metastatique' also reached 'Genetique des formes metastatiques' in a different chapter -- both are metastatic guidance and both were wanted, but one rule spanning two chapters cannot survive a heading being moved. Each chapter names itself.
